programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Ellora Caves are a multi-religious rock-cut cave complex with inscriptions dating from the period 6th century CE onwards, located in the Aurangabad District of Maharashtra, India. There are over 100 caves at the site, all excavated from the basalt cliffs in the Charanandri Hills, 34 of which are open to public. These consist of Hindu , Buddhist & Jain caves whereby each group represents deities and mythologies prevalent in the 1st millennium CE, as well as monasteries of each respective religion.Ellora Caves were inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1983

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Florance is capital city of the Tuscany region , central Italy is in middle of Italian peninusula. The city is noted for its culture, renaissance art and architecture and monuments. Expert inquisite travellers in fields of art, culture and politics should visit Uffizi Gallery and the Palazzo Pitti

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Located in norther Spain’s Andalusia region, in the foothills of the Sierra Nevada mountains, Granda is a perfect fit of culture & architectural patrimony . Palaces , fortress , gardens & renaissance architect makes this place a perfect for those who like to visit heritage sites to study ancient culture. This place is also declared as world heritage site by UNESCO.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.sub-title: Grand Canyon And Monument Valley - America
programme.desc: Grand Canyon , a vast region in Arizona which is formed due to erosion of Colarado river is known for majestic view. Just besides this region is Monument valley is known to be one of the most photographed places on earth.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: An ancient representation of Roman empire during 2nd century AD. It's the most visible and best-known land frontier of the Roman empire. With running over 73 miles in northen England , its a Brithis culture icon. This destination deservingly was designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Aït Benhaddou is a historic village also known as Ksar . The location is alongside caravan route between the Sahara and Marrakesh in Morocco. It has its signature clay architecture & also been declared UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is famous for getting shot in iconic Hollywood movies like Lawrence of Arabia , Gladiator & Jewel Of Nile.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Lima is capital of Peru & has a reputation as a layover on the way to Machu Picchu. This is also a destination in itself offering world-class art museums, preserved colonial plazas, and a trendy, destination-worthy culinary scene featuring a signature cocktail: the Pisco sour.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Lisbon is, among other things, known for its unique historical center, stunning architecture, colorful azulejos (ceramic tiles), and fantastic food. It also has a fascinating history, filled with rulers, invasions, destructions, and re-constructions. History aside, Lisbon is a fantastic place to visit.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Marrakesh, a former imperial city in western Morocco is around 320 km from capital city Rabit. This place built during 10th century by Morbi dynasty is a religious & political center of the country. The vibrant city which has maintained its cultural identity is truly recognized as UNESCO World Heritage Site.

programme.title: Travel Diaries
programme.desc: Capital of Mexico , Mexico City a densely populated city & popular for Aztec temple and its culture. The place is a mixture of modern city along with its signature colonial architecture & iconic artwork. Here one must experience unique Xochimilco Floating Gardens to unwind oneself making this city a memorable visit.
